contexts.text: Make faith separated the principal of religion.
(Origin of the religion concerning beards.)
They placed religion in possessing Knowledges. Signified. AC 1171.
That such a religion prevailed in the Church. Signified.
Men are easily captivated by such a religion. Signified. AC 1179.
The Jews also were in this religion: that all evil is from God...
The truths of conscience are according to each person's religion.
People are saved from every religion, provided... DP 253:2.
It is not to be extinguished because a life of religion. Signified, Explained.
The acknowledgement and adoration of the Lord's Divine Human is the life of religion. Explained.
Those who do good from nature, but not from religion. Treated of, Explained.
That everyone [who is] with others who are in a different doctrine and religion, may learn and accept their goods of charity, but not imbue them and conjoin them with his own truths. Signified.
For thus the doctrinals of all Churches and religions might be called true...
The principles of a false religion (one of the origins of evil).
That religion is to be formed from truths from the Lord... and not from Own intelligence. Signified.
Marriages on earth between those who are of a diverse religion, are in Heaven accounted as heinous... Explained.
Babylon = a religion by which are profaned the holy things of the Word...

Those who think much about religious things, and inhere in them so far as to see them within themselves, begin to hear Spirits speaking to them; for religious things... when a man inheres in them by himself, and does not interrupt them by various things which are of use in the world, penetrate interiorly, and there stay, and occupy the whole spirit of the man, and enter the Spiritual World, and move the Spirits who are there...
The Lord has provided that all may have religion, and by it acknowledgement of the Divine, and interior life; for to live according to what is religious is to live interiorly. Explained.

The first and primary thing of every religion is to acknowledge the Divine: a religion which does not acknowledge the Divine is not a religion; and the precepts of every religion have respect to worship...
He who does no evil to his neighbour because it is contrary to religion, thus contrary to the Divine, abstains, from a spiritual origin, from doing evil...
Conjugial love is not possible between two who are of a diverse religion, because the truth of the one does not agree with the good of the other...

Those of the Mohammedan religion who had led a moral life... are instructed in the Christian religion. Behind these... are the places of instruction for various gentiles who had lived a good life in conformity with their religion...
(References to the subject of falsities of religion.)
Religion separates the good Mohammedans from the Christian Heaven.
Everyone's religion adheres to him there.
All who have dominion as the end, and religion as the means, are Babylon.
Since religion makes the inmost of man...
The Dutch inhere in the principles of their religion more firmly than others...

For everyone is born into the religion of his parents; from infancy is initiated into it; and afterwards retains it; nor can he get away from its falsities on account of his businesses in the world, [This does not condemn]... For he who remains in his own religion, and believes in God, and, within Christendom, in the Lord, and holds the Word holy, and lives from religion, according to the precepts of the decalogue, does not swear [allegiance] to falsities; and therefore, when he hears truths, and perceives them in his own way, he is able to embrace them, and thus be led away from falsities; but not he who has confirmed the falsities of his own religion; for confirmed falsity cannot be extirpated... DSS 93, Described.(See TCR 254.)
(The source of all the religions of the world has been the ancient and the Israelitish Words.) Explained.
That all religion is of life, and that its life is to do what is good. General article.
These laws (of the decalogue) were, in a brief summary, the complex of all things of religion...
The religion has prevailed that no one can (keep the commandments).
It is a General in every religion that man ought to examine himself, perform repentance, and desist from sins...

With all nations... with whom there is religion, there are like precepts... and all those who live them, from religion, are saved; but all who do not live them, from religion, are damned. Those who, from religion, live them, are instructed after death...
From these things it may be (clearly) seen... whether a man has any religion, or not.
Those who know the Divine precepts from religion.
Know nothing more of their religion than...
Uses for receiving the Spiritual... are all things which belong to religion...
For all things of religion... have been (hidden) by the dogma...
(Thus) he has no religion.
All who from religion believe that they are not under the law...
The understanding, being closed... by religion...
(Supposes) he is saved by merely thinking what religion teaches.
What kind of a religion it is to think... and not to do...
(Thus) the common religion of all the Churches in the Christian world is (repentance). DP 127.
If you have religion you will see that repentance... is the way to Heaven.
But if they do not shun evils from a principle of religion... the concupiscences... remain in them...
That man... must not be compelled by external means to think and will... the things of religion... Chapter.
a. [end]. This (harm of speaking with the dead) results only when the Spirits bring in some dogma of religion; which is never done by any good Spirit.

Those who suffer themselves to be forced to religion are many of the papists... Those who do not suffer themselves to be forced are many of the English; there is consequently an internal in their worship... Their interiors as to religion appear like bright clouds; but the interiors of the former, as to religion, appear like dark clouds.
The religion which teaches blind faith, darkens the understanding.
The religion of the Christian world has closed the understanding...
If they have no religion, they become worshippers of nature... But if they have a religion, they become worshippers of men...
This... every Gentile acknowledges from his religion.
If they retain in the memory something from religion.
The state of religion in various nations. Explained.
Religion has been transplanted into the whole world from the Ancient and Israelitish Words.

When a religion has once been implanted, that nation is led by the Lord according to the precepts and dogmas of its religion; and the Lord provides that in every religion there are precepts such as are in the decalogue...
Those whom the Gospel has not reached, but only a religion (are) able to have a place in the (Grand Man) by constituting the... skins, bones, etc.
Provided they shun evils... because they are contrary to religion.
From Mohammed, that religion has been called the Mohammedan religion. This religion was raised up of the Divine Providence...
The reason the Christian religion is in Europe only... For a religion not accommodated is not received. Explained.
Although this faith (alone) has become of religion, every one knows that faith does not save...
(Thinks that the Divine Providence would have caused one true religion to exist throughout the world). Explained.
Whether they know that to shun evils as sins is religion itself...
In all who have any religion, there is implanted the knowledge that they live as men after death. Shown.
a. 2. Of those who, from religion, omit the search (for sin in themselves). Explained.
(Such) do not admit any truth which leads away from any falsity of their religion.

It is of the Divine Providence that every nation has some religion; and the primary thing of all religion is to acknowledge that there is a God; for otherwise it is not called a religion; and every nation which lives its religion, that is, which does not do evil because it is contrary to its God, receives something spiritual in its Natural. Explained.
For a Gentile more than a Christian thinks of God from religion in his life.
There are most general principles of the Church which enter into all religions, and make this Communion.
These are the general principles of all religions, by which everyone can be saved.
All can Know God who know anything from religion.
That the good of life... is to shun evils because they are contrary to religion. Explained.

That these are the generals of all religions, by which everyone can be saved. - To acknowledge God, and not to do evil because it is contrary to God, are the two things which make religion to be religion: if one is wanting, it cannot be called a religion. Explained.
It has been provided... that almost everywhere there is some religion, and that these two things are in it...
The Grand Man cannot be composed from the men of one religion; but from the men of many religions...
Whence comes the appropriation of evil, even until religion perishes. Explained.
That in process of time every religion decreases and is consummated. Explained.
That every religion decreases and is consummated through the inversion of the image of God with man. Explained.
When, in the Church, this (lust of seducing to evil) has taken possession of the leaders... religion becomes perverted...
The religion that works effect nothing...
Heaven is such that all who live well, from whatever religion, have a place there.
Those born out of the Church... have a religion from which they acknowledge that there is a God, and that they must live well...
That by (instantaneous Salvation from immediate mercy) religion is abolished. Explained.
There are two essentials, and at the same time universals, of religion: the acknowledgement of God, and repentance...
Preface. The Doctrinals of the Roman Catholic Church and Religion. Quoted.
The Doctrinals of the Church and Religion of the Reformed. Quoted.
That still they have religion, and worship according to it... Signified, Explained.
That from these there is Divine truth in the whole world where there is religion. Signified, Explained.
That those have been redeemed... who, in any Church, or in any religion, are in truths as to doctrine, and in goods as to life. Signified, Explained.
A tribe = the Church as to religion. ( = religion as to the good of life. AR 349.)
All in the Christian world who are in religion from good, and in truths from doctrine. Signified, Explained.
That the good of life is not religion where there is faith alone.
(A discussion as to whether the good which man does in a state of justification by faith is the good of religion, or not.) TCR 390.
The last boundary of the Spiritual World, where those were collected who have religion and thence worship, and no good of life. Signified, Explained.
At this day, in the Christian world, there is no longer any Church, or any religion. Explained. TCR 389.
Who can deny that religion is to slum what is evil and do what is good? Is there any religion where it is taught that faith alone saves... Explained.
(Angels sent to see whether they had any religion, or not. They determined it by their idea of God; for this idea enters into everything of religion.)
That these alone are in the doctrine of love to God, and of love towards the neighbour, which two are the foundations of religion. Signified, Explained.
That all the truth of the Church, and all the good of religion, are from Him. Signified.
For the Church is one thing, and religion another. The Church is so called from doctrine, and religion is called religion from a life according to doctrine...
a. [end]. For a Christian to have a plurality of wives infests and profanes religion.

(They told us) to say nothing against religion... We asked, What does your religion teach about marriages... (They said), The understanding is insane in the mysteries from which is all religion; and what have deeds to do with religion?
The human Conjugial, and religion, go hand in hand...
The state of religion at this day. Signified.
The reason the chastity of marriage does not come forth by the renunciation of scortations, unless this is done from religion, is that without religion man does not become spiritual...
That internal causes of colds (between married partners) are from religion. Explained. CL 240. CL 241. CL 242. CL 243.
(Thus) where there is no religion, there is no conjugial love; (but) there is cold...
Although there is religion (now), still there are no truths of religion; and what is religion without truths?

I entered a house where the consorts were of a diverse religion... The Angels said. We cannot remain with you in that house, because the consorts there are in discordant religion. This they perceived from the internal disunion of their souls.
Internal similitudes and dissimilitudes arise from religion; for religion is implanted in souls; and through souls from the parents is transmitted into the offspring, as the supreme inclination.
He (attains these blessednesses of conjugial love) if he approaches the Lord, and from Him lives true religion.
The rise of the Mohammedan religion. Explained.
A new religion accommodated to the genius of the Orientals...
That polygamy is not sin to those who live in it from religion.
They who live according to these laws, from religion, are saved.
That at last (these adulterers) reject from themselves all things of the Church and of religion. Explained.
(Talk of the satyrs about religion.)
Religion, being the marriage of the Lord and the Church, is the initiament and inoculation of conjugial love.
That the present faith has separated religion (which consists in the acknowledgement of one God, and in the worship of Him from the faith of charity) from the Church...
It is a general rule of religion that...
There is not a nation, possessed of religion and sound reason, which does not acknowledge... that God is one. Explained.
Carry the things of religion as in a sack on their backs.
(The idea of a satan about religion.)
Those who know nothing about the Lord... if they... live according to the precepts of their religion, are saved...
They found that the backs of their heads were hollow; and then said to them... In your hearts you have denied God, and despised religion.
(The commandments) were thus made laws of religion also. Explained.
For God is in all things of religion... and hears.
To turn away the souls of men from... religion, is to commit spiritual murder.
They (who commit adultery in the celestial sense) at heart laugh at everything of religion...
They who confirm the falsities of religion...
When the conversation is about religion, they discuss it...
(The religion of a so-called Reformed Christian.) Described.
(The religion of a true Christian.) Described.
Without these three things there is not religion.
a. (The internal character of those who live a moral life, but at heart reject the things of religion.) (Described by comparisons.)
In childhood (there), as he learns the first lessons of religion, he leaves the north for the south.
What then would religion be but an idle word? And what is the Church without religion...
(The real sentiments of the predestinarians about religion.)
That... those repent (also), who, from religion, do the works of charity. General article.
All who do what is good from religion, both Christians and pagans, are acceptable to the Lord...
All who do what is good from religion, after death reject the present doctrine of three Divine persons... and turn to the Lord...
Those who do what is good from natural goodness only, and not at the same time from religion, are not accepted after death. Explained.
He who has not searched himself... has not a religion...
If the present faith were to continue... what would religion be, but a lamentation that one is a sinner...
Religion alone renews and regenerates man; for religion occupies the highest seat in the mind...
Everyone is (there) examined... as to what he had been in respect to religion...
(Everyone) who is endowed with religion... will say that those who do good will go to Heaven...
Conscience is... a spiritual willingness to do according to what is of religion...
Every man imbued with religion... may know... that there is (also) a spiritual nourishment...
That for anyone to have religion, God must be acknowledged...
(Other) infants... are introduced into the Heaven assigned to their religion...
Those who believe that religion is a mere affair of politics (correspond to bed-bugs).
Charles XII wished to introduce natural religion, adapted to the comprehension of all naturalists.
The secrets of the Moravian religion concerning the Lord.
Interiorly religious, and exteriorly wicked. SE 4950.
It is not allowable to speak to the Dutch about religion.
All (there) have with them the religion they had (here).
On a Hell where they are continually wrangling about religious things.
All they had had of religion, not profaned, remains.
For where there is no life, there is no religion...
For a religion which does not teach life, or according to which is the life, is not a religion.
All who had lived... in a religion without religion...
(The difference between acting well from religion, and from merely external bonds.)
(The Russian nation) do not care for religion.
On the profane from various religions.
By the common speech of Spirits all... of every religion (can be together).
By this speech from ideas and affections... those in a diverse religion (cannot have any social intercourse with one another).
a. Those who have consulted together about a union of religions...
a. They were told to remain in their own religion...
People are saved from every religion... provided they live the life of faith, which is charity... and thus do not imbue inwardly things diabolical...
They cannot apprehend the things of religion.
They become pagans of no religion.
All such (dragonists) live in the world as if without religion.
Destroy those who were of the Reformed religion.
This pope associated himself with the worst of his own religion.
On those heathen who have had no knowledge of God, or of religion.
On those who make the Lutheran religion of life.
When they begin to think from their own minds... they reject religion...
Religion makes a man spiritual. Explained.
Those who study religious things.
A man lives a moral life from a spiritual origin when he lives it from religion. Explained.
(So) many gentiles think that evil is not to be done, because it is contrary to their religion...
They call this way practical religion; the other, Christian religion.
All in the good of life according to their religion, in which are not genuine truths. Representation.
Those only undergo temptations there who (here) have lived well according to their religion, in which had been falsities...
With all who are in truths and goods as to life, and at the same time in goods and truths as to doctrine, according to each person's religion. Signified, Explained.
(Heaven for) all who worship the Lord, from every religion. Signified, Explained.
That the man should relinquish that evil and falsity which he has from religion... Signified.
That in this faith there is no religion. Explained.
Good works are all things which a man does... when he lives according to the laws of his own religion. The laws of our religion are... AE 825:4.
All religion has life for its end... A religion which has not... cannot be called a religion...
(Thus) man cannot become spiritual... except through a life according to religion, from the Lord.
For religion does not consist in thinking this or that; but in willing and doing what is thought...
Religion with man consists in a life according to the Divine precepts... With him who does not live according to them, there cannot be religion. Explained.
For no one can have religion except from revelation.
For the religion and doctrine of faith separated from good works, is a religion and doctrine of truth separated from good...
Their religion is founded upon the keys...
Why there are so many [religions].
That the Lord provides that man can be reformed and saved by the things he thence makes of his religion. Explained.
Thus (is everyone saved) in his own religion, whether Christian, Mohammedan, or Gentile.
The English have an interior sight as to religion; but it is a receptive sight. Explained.
The Dutch are constant in the Things of their religion.
They appeared on the east because they love a bare religion without images.
2. 3. (On account of the respiration) a nation of one religion cannot enter to nations of another religion...
There is no... religion where there is no good of life. General article.
The Church, and religion, make a one, like good and truth.
Preface. The whole of religion is founded upon the idea of God, and follows according to it.
They are collected into Heavens distinctly, according to religion; thus according to faith and love.
Religion is not possible except through some revelation, and through the propagation of this from nation to nation.

To accomplish this end (the formation of a Heaven from mankind) what promotive and effective mediate cause is there but religion? And what is religion but walking with God? Moreover, religion is like a seed producing just and true desires, and thence judgments and acts, in spiritual things; and, through these, in moral ones... and civil ones.
The quality of a man who has religion; and that of a man who has not religion (shown by comparisons.)
God is the all in all of the Church and its religion.
Whence their religion was not a religion, but a superstition.
